name: base1-openjev-recovery-combat
scope: Original base1 BSP/AAS and movers/items/barrels. Original monsters removed; one vulnerable Parasite and one ordinary health kit. No god, forced model answer or mid-fight teleport/give. Go owns recovery priority; System1 combat decisions are independently recorded.
acceptance: Native enemy damage lowers health below 45 and causes recovery goal
At least two actual steps approach the kit while preserving enemy aim and attack
Native enemy health damage during the recovery interval is positive
The observed kit disappears near the actor as authoritative server playerstate health increases; simultaneous damage may reduce the net gain below 25
Recovery firing projectile spawn matches command frame/spawncount and deals shot-ID-linked native monster damage
Combat resumes after healing, Parasite is killed, and ordinary campaign route movement resumes after the kill
No death, map transition, teammate, god or extra gameplay intervention; acknowledged distinct seeds, 2x, parallelism 2, unchanged source fingerprint
remaining_scope: Hidden remembered kit, inaccessible treatment and nightmare survival require separate acceptance.
